extracted.intended_audience: scientists, engineers, and research institutions seeking training in public engagement and science communication
extracted.subtask_description: Workshops and training sessions to help scientists and engineers develop public engagement and science communication skills so they can explain research, tailor messages to audiences, and establish meaningful dialogue with diverse publics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use evidence-based workshop content and evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: The program worked closely with social scientists and a professional evaluator to ensure the program used empirical evidence to inform best practices and workshop content, and to develop an evaluation program measuring progress toward research-informed goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AAAS collaborated with researchers to align workshop design and evaluation with social-science research on science communication and public engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase participants' communication skills and confidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation results showed an increase in workshop participants’ self-reported communication skills and confidence as a result of participating in the workshop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measured via participant self-report in evaluation program; overarching program goal for success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe scientific findings in ways relevant to specific people
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants indicated that they could 'Describe scientific findings in ways that make them relevant to specific people.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes connecting findings to audience-specific interests, concerns, or contexts so the science feels meaningful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get people excited about science
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants reported an increased ability to 'Get people excited about science.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes using engaging framing, narrative, or examples to spark interest and enthusiasm in non-expert audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Frame research implications to resonate with people's values
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants reported being better able to 'Frame research implications so they resonate with people's values.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on values-based framing — translate implications into what matters to the audience rather than only technical details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listen and 'hear what others think' about scientific issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants reported increased ability to 'Hear what others think about scientific issues.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied two-way engagement: develop listening skills, solicit perspectives, and incorporate audience feedback into communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articulate a communication goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Regarding specific skills, workshop participants reported an increased ability to 'Articulate a goal for communication.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Begin communications by identifying clear, specific objectives (e.g., inform, persuade, motivate action, build trust).

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify the relevance of a message to an audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants reported improved ability to 'Identify relevance of message to an audience.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess audience background, concerns, and priorities and tailor messages to align with those factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify a few main points/messages to convey
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants reported increased ability to 'Identify a few main points/messages to convey.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize and simplify content into a small number of clear takeaways rather than many details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be concise and jargon-free
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants reported improved capacity to 'Be concise and jargon-free.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid technical terms or explain them simply; keep messages short and accessible without 'dumbing down' content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailor messages and meet people where they are
rubrics_metrics.description: Workshop participants emphasized the importance of 'tailoring my message to each specific audience, and meeting people where they already are.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adapt tone, examples, framing, and delivery channel to audience knowledge, values, and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable meaningful dialogue with diverse audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Program aim: enable participants to establish meaningful dialogue with diverse audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Move beyond one-way information delivery toward engagement strategies that foster conversation, trust, and mutual understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster institutional community for public engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional reported benefits included fostering a community for public engagement within an institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workshops aim to build networks and institutional support for ongoing engagement activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase institutional awareness of interest in public engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants reported 'increased awareness of others’ interest in this work.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A successful program raises visibility of public engagement as a valued activity within organizations and helps identify potential collaborators.
